{{Spell InfoBox|image=Reflection.png|type=Spell Boost|rarity=Normal|spell_damage1=x80%|spell_damage2=x85%|spell_damage3=x90%|misc_a_1=When hitting the enemy, the spell will bounce to the nearest enemy 2 times|misc_a_2=When hitting the enemy, the spell will bounce to the nearest enemy 3 times|misc_a_3=When hitting the enemy, the spell will bounce to the nearest enemy 5 times}}'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Rarity|Normal]] [[Spells|Spell]] of [[Spell Types|Type]]: Spell Boost. It allows a spell to hit an enemy, bounce off them, and potentially hit another enemy with a single cast. Higher Spell Reflection levels allow more enemies to be bounced off.

'''Description:''' When both refelction and penetration are present, reflection takes priority
